column2: I am shopping for good food, sealed drinks and treats for the household. Show me what is fresh.
The salon is debating which soda deserves proper glassware. I think the answer is all of them.
My friends keep asking where I found these drinks. I prefer a reliable shop to an impressive address.
Someone served ordinary noodles at a formal dinner and called them a rediscovered tradition.
The latest fashion is to praise simple food in very complicated language.
The galleries are preparing another opening. Everyone remembers the refreshments first.
I am organizing a small evening gathering. Small is a surprisingly flexible word to my guests.
Our cook wants to know who supplies your ingredients. I told her to ask you herself.
One of my neighbors collects empty bottles. I am helping with the enjoyable half of that hobby.
A tasting party is a wonderful way to discover that nobody agrees about sweetness.
The upper lifts are crowded today. I would rather wait here with a decent drink.
I'll come by tomorrow. I'm looking for {0}.
